annotations.title: Live Multi-Engine SERP & AI Overview Search

description: Execute a real-time Search Engine Results Page (SERP) query across Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, Google News, or Google AI Overviews. Use this tool to inspect live organic rankings, People Also Ask questions, and generative AI Overview source citations for any target keyword. Returns ranked organic listings, AI Overview synthesis with cited URLs, SERP feature flags, and traffic estimates in Managed Edge or BYOK mode.

country.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for localized geo-targeting such as "us", "gb", "de", or "es" (default: "us").

engine.description: Target search engine vertical to query (default: "google").

execution_mode.description: Execution mode: "managed" ($0.0005 per query via Argosor Global Edge) or "byok" ($0 markup using encrypted vault credentials).

include_ai_overview.description: When true, extracts the Google AI Overview generative summary and cited source URLs (default: true).

include_people_also_ask.description: When true, extracts People Also Ask (PAA) questions and answer snippets (default: true).

language.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code for SERP localization such as "en", "es", or "fr" (default: "en").

limit.description: Maximum number of organic SERP results to return between 1 and 30 (default: 10).

query.description: Search query or keyword phrase to inspect in real time (e.g., "best seo api for ai agents").

name: serp_live_search
title: Live Multi-Engine SERP & AI Overview Search
